text:
sam_pd: Pushing a compact roles matrix mock + invite preview to Figma for the RBAC panel. Goal: reduce vertical space for orgs with 40+ roles. Figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-matrix

maya_pm: Nice — main things I care about: invite flow clarity (which role is preselected), SSO toggle visibility, and audit log link discoverability.

liam_fe: Quick notes from the implementation side: collapsing rows is fine but we need a keyboard-friendly expand/collapse and an efficient DOM (virtualize rows). Thinking: use button with aria-expanded + aria-controls.

keisha_a11y: Agree on aria-expanded. Also check focus order when the invite preview modal opens — focus should go to the modal header close button then the form. Current mock jumps focus to role chips, which is confusing for screen reader users.

sam_pd: Good catch. I'll update mock to put focus on the modal heading and include a skip-to-invite-link at top.

andre_security: For SSO toggle, avoid ambiguous copy. Instead of "Enable SSO", can we use "Require SSO for all org members" when on? Need to be explicit about scope. Also audit logs need a clear breadcrumb path for compliance teams.

maya_pm: +1 on clearer SSO copy. UX question: should SSO be a top-level banner in org settings (prominent) or nested under Security? Security wants it nested, but onboarding teams want it visible.

liam_fe: If it's a banner we can show it once with dismiss and add a persistent control in Security. Banner would be ARIA role="region" with aria-live for status changes.

keisha_a11y: Banner readable by screen readers, but watch color contrast. Current yellow banner text is #7A5E00 on #FFF7CC -> contrast 3.0:1 which fails AA for body text. Either darken text (#5A4200) or use bold to increase perceived contrast. Prefer meeting 4.5:1.

sam_pd: I'll switch to #4A3000 for the heading and update the body copy. Also adding tooltip copy for SSO toggle: "Require single sign-on for all new and existing members". Thoughts?

andre_security: That tooltip copy is clearer. Also, when SSO is required we should disable invite-by-email unless org owner overrides with a safety modal. Need a confirm that lists affected resources.

liam_fe: For the roles matrix compact mode: propose a collapsed row UI where each row shows role name, member count, and a kebab menu. Expand reveals permissions grid. Use <button class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false">▸</button>. We should animate height but keep reduced motion preference in mind.

keisha_a11y: Add data that screen readers need: role header should be h3 and the toggle button should include aria-controls pointing to the permissions table id. Add visually-hidden text: "Expand permissions for <role name>".

sam_pd: Invite preview: showing role badges inline was requested. But some roles have very long names. Proposal: truncate at 18 chars with tooltip showing full name; also allow keyboard focus to open the full-name tooltip.

maya_pm: Love that. Minor copy tweak for invite CTA: change "Send invite" -> "Send invite — role: <selected role>" when role is selected, so you don't have to re-open the dropdown.

liam_fe: On the code side I can append aria-label to the button: `button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Send invite, role: ' + selectedRole)` so screen readers get it.

keisha_a11y: Confirm modal for owner change needs clear heading: "Change Organization Owner" and list the implications (billing, billing contact, audit access). Use role="alertdialog" and ensure both confirm/cancel have visible focus styles (#1F6FEB ring) and 4.5:1 contrast.

andre_security: Audit log discovery: can we add a persistent quick link in the top-right org header called "Audit" that anchors to /orgs/:id/audit? Security teams like persistent nav for investigations.

sam_pd: I sketched two options: breadcrumb route (in Settings > Security > Audit) and persistent header link. Will upload both for quick vote.

maya_pm: Team vote: persistent header link + crumb path from inside settings. That should satisfy both.

liam_fe: Minor CSS snippet for focus ring I suggest: 
```
:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,111,235,0.18); }
```
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and don't animate box-shadow.

keisha_a11y: For keyboard users also add `:focus-visible` support so mouse clicks don't show the ring. And ensure the ring color meets contrast with background.

sam_pd: I'll update Figma: add aria notes on components, focus flows, and copy variants for SSO and invite CTA. Thanks for the quick review — I'll ping again once mocks are updated. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: updated deps OK, visual-diff flagged 3 components (roles-row, invite-modal, settings-banner).

liam_fe: I'll take the visual diffs tomorrow and iterate on DOM perf.

keisha_a11y: I'll run a quick axe pass on the updated figma once it's ready.

maya_pm: Great. Close loop: Sam, please include the copy alternatives in the PR description so legal/security can sign off quickly.

sam_pd: Will do — thanks all!
